abilities.name: Resonance Beam
abilities.description: Tassadar's Basic Attack is a Channeled beam that Slows by 15%. While Channeling, your Basic Attack damage and Mana Regeneration increase by 25% a second, to a maximum of 100%. While at full charge, gain an additional 3 Mana per second. This bonus is lost after 6 seconds of not Channeling.; trait

fields.notes: Each tick grants 6.25% Resonance Beam charge. Gaining charge in any way resets the duration. Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Tassadar's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Shock Ray
abilities.description: Channel a beam of Psionic energy, dealing 280 damage and Slowing enemies in a line by 30% for 2 seconds.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Slow, Stationary channel
fields.notes: Tassadar can start moving after the channel although there is an additional 0.0625s delay (noted above) before the beam appears from its cast location. Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 0.5 second cooldown. Cooldown does not start until the channel completely finishes. It is possible to reduce the cast time to 0.1 seconds through an input buffer: W > Basic Attack > Q (buffer is easier to execute while Archon is active).

abilities.name: Psionic Storm
abilities.description: Create a Psionic Storm at the targeted location for 3 seconds. While in a storm, enemies take 38 damage every 0.5 seconds, increasing by 20% for each consecutive instance of damage, up to 100%.

fields.tickrate: - Damage: 2.0 per second (x6) - Target search: 4.0 per second (x11)
fields.notes: Enemies can only be affected by one Psionic Storm at a time. This also applies in the event there are multiple Tassadars in a team. Damage bonus tracks each target separately and can carry over to another cast of Psionic Storm, if it damages the target within 0.4 seconds of the last damage instance. This also applies to Psionic Storms cast by different Tassadars. A target with no existing stacks that is hit by a full-duration Storm will take 342 damage (excluding scaling and other damage modifiers). Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and offensive damage modifiers.

abilities.name: Force Wall
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second delay, create a wall that blocks all units from moving through it for 2 seconds.; 18 / 0.5

fields.notes: 1) Area consists of four overlapping circular blocking units with 1.0625 radius. Force Wall can be reactivated 0.5 seconds after it has spawned to end its effect early. Force Wall grants vision in 6 radius.

abilities.name: Archon
abilities.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds. Resonance Beam Deals 140 damage to the target and splashes 70 damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.; 90; 100; heroic

fields.type: Physical Damage, Defensive damage modifier / Shield
fields.props: Attack Modifier, Spell Armor reduction, Splash
fields.notes: Tassadar cannot Mount while in this form. Cooldown starts when the transformation ends. Archon benefits from Resonance Beam 's Slow and Mana regeneration bonuses, but not from the damage bonus. Archon attacks benefit from all talents enhancing Resonance Beam, except Khaydarin Amulet. Does not stack with itself or other negative Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.description: After a 0.5 second cast, launch a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled toward its center. Touching the center deals 310 damage and Stuns for 1.25 seconds.; 60; 60; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Displacement, Stun
fields.notes: Interrupting the cast during its windup puts the Ability on a 10 second cooldown. Pull from Black Hole does not apply Daze, allowing the target to control their Hero's movement and actions as normal and causing it to be unable to interrupt channels (without getting hit by its center). Heroes hit by the center continue to be pulled until they leave Black Hole's area, but cannot be hit by the center again.

talents.name: Static Charge
talents.description: Questonly Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increase its damage by 5 and grant 33% Resonance Beam charge. Maximum of 200 additional damage.
_raw_fields: Questonly Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increase its damage by 5 and grant 33% Resonance Beam charge. Maximum of 200 additional damage.

talents.name: Psi-Infusion
talents.description: Increases the range of Psionic Storm by 33%. Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.

fields.notes: Mana refund can trigger multiple times on the same target.

_raw_fields: Increases the range of Psionic Storm by 33%. Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.

talents.name: Khaydarin Amulet
talents.description: Quest Resonance Beam charges 50% faster. After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 80 seconds, it bounces to hit 1 additional target for 75% damage. Reward After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 160 seconds, it bounces to hit 2 additional targets for 75% damage.

fields.notes: Bounce radius is extended by the target's unit radius. Bounces chain from the secondary target. Secondary attacks Slow. Secondary targets do not grant additional charge. Archon Basic Attacks do not bounce. Damage reduction to both bounces is relative to damage dealt to primary target. Damage reduction to secondary targets stacks multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Tassadar's Basic Attack damage. Target must be visible to initially bounce to them, and then is revealed while linked.

_raw_fields: Quest Resonance Beam charges 50% faster. After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 80 seconds, it bounces to hit 1 additional target for 75% damage. Reward After Resonance Beam has been fully charged for 160 seconds, it bounces to hit 2 additional targets for 75% damage.

fields.notes: Reduces the cooldown of Shock Ray by 0.125 seconds every 0.125 seconds. Slow duration is determined when the Ability hits the target. Gaining or losing full Resonance Beam charge does not affect the duration.

talents.name: Psionic Echo
talents.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

fields.notes: The Psionic Storm created by Psionic Echo benefits from all talents affecting Psionic Storm.

talents.name: Arc Discharge
talents.description: When Resonance Beam is fully charged, Tassadar's Basic Attack range is increased by 1 and its next instance of damage also creates a Psionic Storm on the target. This effect has a 20 second cooldown that decays twice as fast while Resonance Beam is fully charged.

fields.notes: Secondary targets from Khaydarin Amulet and Archon do not generate a Psionic Storm. A Psionic Storm created by Arc Discharge interacts with all Talents affecting Psionic Storm. Does not benefit from cooldown reduction granted by Executor's Will.

talents.name: Feedback
talents.description: When an enemy Hero is affected by Psionic Storm, Resonance Beam's Slow is increased to 50% and it reduces Physical Armor by 25.

fields.notes: Basic Attacks apply the debuff for 0.5 seconds, subsequent applications refreshing the duration. While Archon is active, the duration of the debuff is increased to 2 seconds. Secondary attacks from Khaydarin Amulet can trigger the effect. Debuff applies after the triggering Basic Attack's damage is calculated. Does not stack with itself or other negative Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Shadow Walk
talents.description: Cooldown 60 Tassadar becomes Stealthed and Unrevealable, but cannot attack or use Abilities for 1.5 seconds. While this effect is active gain 40% increased Movement Speed and 35 Armor. Can be cast while channeling Shock Ray.

fields.notes: Can also be cast while channeling Black Hole. Shadow Walk can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to end its effect early. Activating Shadow Walk during the windup of Shock Ray or Black Hole puts the Abilities on their respective shorter cooldowns. If Shock Ray is interrupted this way after the windup, the Ability ends immediately and is put on full cooldown.

talents.name: Oracle
talents.description: Cooldown 45 Passive While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 Health per second. Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

fields.type: Status effect / Defensive damage modifier, Healing
fields.props: Area of Effect, Stationary channel, Revealed, Spell Armor
fields.notes: 1) Reveal area radius grows in 0.5 increments every 0.125 seconds. Vision and Revealed status persists for 2 seconds after Tassadar stops channeling. Does not stack with itself or other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Psychic Shock
talents.description: Psionic Storm deals damage 25% faster.

fields.notes: Actually deals damage 33.3~% faster because it sets the period of the AoE to 74.5% of its original (.375s instead of .5s). Duration remains the same, causing Psionic Storm to tick an additional 2 times. Results in up to a ~44.4% increase in total damage to someone who stands in its entire duration, due to its ramping.

talents.name: Executor's Will
talents.description: Cooldown 60 Activate to gain full Resonance Beam charge, 20% Spell Power, and cause Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns to regenerate 25% faster. This effect lasts as long as Resonance Beam remains at full charge.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Cooldown starts when the Ability is cast. Spell Power from Executor's Will does not stack with itself, but stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting Tassadar's Spell Damage or healing output.

fields.notes: Psionic Storms created by Kugelblitz benefit from all talents affecting Psionic Storm. Armor debuff is not cleansed by Stasis. Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Khala's Gift
talents.description: Gain 4% Spell Power for yourself and each nearby ally Hero, up to 20% total Spell Power. Your total bonus is shared with all contributing allies.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Searches for allies in range every 0.25 seconds. Lingers for 0.3125 seconds after going out of range. Spell Power from Khala's Gift stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting the target Hero's Spell Damage or healing output.
